The AI computing cost gap is staggering—why are research budgets still going up in smoke? 🔥

Handshake AI launched VIALS, an independent leaderboard, and found that the costs of top AI models differ by as much as 99 times. When spending research budgets, efficiency matters.

Handshake AI put together VIALS, a leaderboard evaluating scientific image AI models, with rankings conducted by an independent third party. The results are shocking: the most expensive model costs 99 times as much as the cheapest one! Put simply, some AI computing power really is worth every penny—but what costs one model a penny can cost another 99 pennies. Research funds are being drained in plain sight.

Impact on the market
- Short term: The AI computing race will keep burning through cash, but if efficiency doesn't keep up, it'll become a joke. Investors will be watching closely to see whose algorithms offer the best value.
- Medium term: The scientific AI field could see a race to cut costs and improve efficiency, while high-cost solutions that don't deliver will be淘汰.

My take
This has limited impact on ordinary cryptocurrencies, but in the long run, the AI cost war could spill over into computing-power tokens. After all, if money is being burned on inefficient AI, growth in demand for computing power will slow too. Go easy on me if I'm wrong—I'm only testing this direction with a small position myself. $1,600 is a stress test, not a prediction. If it really falls that far, short-term investors will feel the pain first. Whether application teams stick around depends on whether there’s paying demand on-chain.

The current price is $2,232.75, down 1% over 24 hours and virtually unchanged over 7 days, moving back and forth between support at $2,164 and resistance at $2,311. Glamsterdam won’t be included in the Hoodi fork for now, because risks involving 8 smart contract invariants remain unresolved. In practice, this means security takes priority over upgrade speed. Applications that depend on new features, auditors, and infrastructure providers will be affected. A drop to $1,600 won’t kill the technology roadmap, but it will weed out teams that depend on subsidies to stay afloat, leaving products that people are genuinely willing to pay for. I’m not sure when long-term investors will return either; that depends on whether ETF inflows recover.

translatedData.subTitle:
On emotionally charged days, people forget every principle, so I wrote them down and put them up where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position. Never average down.
4. After three consecutive losing trades, stop trading for the day. Just watch; don’t trade.
5. Withdraw part of your profits. The money you take out is money; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

That’s all five. Not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market—it’s that their execution falls apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

translatedData.content:
ETH client fix proposal under review | Network reliability is not an upside catalyst | Wait and see near $2,230

My stance is cautious and wait-and-see. On November 6, a PR appeared in the official repository for Ethereum’s execution client Geth: PR #36076, titled “Fix RPC calls getting stuck due to connection failure during request sending.” The commit description says that when an error in the read loop races with the completion of sending a request, some Client.Call calls without a timeout may wait indefinitely; the proposal adds a test for this sequence. The author reports that, under the same workload in their local tests, the old version got stuck 19 times in 20,715 runs, while the modified version got stuck zero times in 23,143 runs. These figures are only the submitter’s test results and cannot be extrapolated to the mainnet failure rate. The PR is still open and has not been merged or released, so it should not be described as a fix already completed by Ethereum, much less as evidence that on-chain assets were affected.

Why should traders pay attention to engineering details like this? RPC is the entry point through which wallets, trading applications, and data services read chain state or submit transactions. In an extreme case, an unresponsive request could prolong application confirmations or risk-control processing. If a subsequent fix passes review and makes it into an official release, it could improve application reliability, but it will not directly change ETH supply, fee revenue, or ETF inflows. Treating a development proposal as immediate buying pressure confuses a “potential operational improvement” with “realized capital inflows.” This round’s Binance Square trending topics had no rising tag directly related to this PR. ETH appeared under Most Searched, but search interest alone is not evidence of net buying.

As for the market, at the time of writing ETH/USD was around $2,231 on Kraken, with a daily open of $2,235, an intraday low of $2,201, and a high of $2,247; the 24-hour high was $2,266. The price remains within the day’s range, with no evidence that the market has independently repriced ETH because of this PR. The latest data released by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics showed 165,000 new nonfarm jobs in October and an unemployment rate of 4.1%. Macroeconomic interest-rate expectations may still explain short-term volatility better than a single client proposal; the Federal Reserve’s latest statement kept the federal funds target range at 3.75% to 4%. On ETF flows, Farside lists combined net outflows of about $99.9 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 5. Its November 6 page still shows incomplete placeholder entries, so I will not treat placeholder figures as today’s flow data.

My key levels are the intraday low of $2,201, the intraday high of $2,247, and the 24-hour upper boundary of $2,266. If ETH falls below $2,201 and a rebound fails to reclaim it, I will have to abandon my current expectation of a rebound. If it regains and holds above $2,247 and breaks through $2,266, that would indicate an improvement in short-term demand, though this would still need confirmation from final ETF data and overall risk appetite. If the PR is closed or amended, the engineering argument will also need to be reassessed.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. My tentative direction is a conditional spot long, with a position size of 0%. Only if ETH regains and holds above $2,247, then breaks decisively above $2,266 and holds on a retest, would I consider a test position of no more than 0.8% of total capital. I would not use leverage. The first target is $2,290, where I would reduce the position by half; the second target is $2,320, where I would exit the rest in stages. After entry, if the price falls back below $2,247 and fails to reclaim it, I would close the position at a loss. Even if the stop-loss is not hit, I would exit the entire position if final ETF data continued to show significant outflows and macro risk appetite deteriorated. If these conditions are not met, I will remain flat and will not present a plan as a completed trade.

#ETH
This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETH客户端修复提案待审｜网络可靠性不能当上涨催化｜2230美元附近先观望

我的态度是谨慎观望。以太坊执行客户端Geth官方仓库11月6日出现PR #36076，标题是修复“发送请求期间连接失败导致RPC调用卡住”。提交说明指出，读取循环报错与请求发送完成的先后顺序发生竞争时，某些没有超时期限的Client.Call可能一直等待；提案增加了针对这一顺序的测试。作者报告，在其本地相同负载下，旧版本20715次运行中出现19次卡住，修改版23143次运行中为零。这里的数字只是提交者测试结果，不能外推为主网故障率。目前PR仍是Open，尚未合并或发布，不能写成以太坊已经完成修复，更不能据此声称链上资产受损。

为什么交易员要看这类工程细节？RPC是钱包、交易应用和数据服务读取链状态或提交交易的入口。极端情况下请求无响应，会拉长应用确认或风控处理时间；如果后续修复通过审查并进入正式版本，有利于应用可靠性，但它不会直接改变ETH供给、费用收入或ETF申购。把开发提案当成立即买盘，是把“潜在运营改进”误读成“已兑现资金流入”。本轮币安广场热榜没有与该PR直接对应的上升标签，Most Searched可见ETH，但搜索热度本身也不是净买入证据。

行情上，写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2231美元，日开2235美元，盘中低点2201、高点2247，过去24小时高点2266。价格仍在日内区间，没有证据显示市场因这条PR而单独重估ETH。美国劳工统计局最新公布的10月非农新增16.5万人、失业率4.1%，宏观利率预期仍可能比单个客户端提案更能解释短线波动；美联储最近一次声明维持联邦基金目标区间3.75%至4%。ETF资金方面，Farside所列11月5日美国现货ETH基金合计约净流出9990万美元，11月6日页面仍是未完整填报的占位，不拿占位数当今日资金结论。

我的关键位是2201美元的日内低点、2247美元的日内高点和2266美元的24小时上沿。若跌破2201且回抽不能站回，当前等待反弹的判断就要推翻；若重新站稳2247并突破2266，才说明短线需求有所改善，仍需结合ETF最终数据和整体风险偏好确认。PR若被关闭或修改，也要重新评估工程层面的论点。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向暂定条件式现货做多，仓位0%。只有ETH重新站稳2247、随后有效突破2266且回踩不失守，我才考虑用总资金最多0.8%试单，不使用杠杆。第一目标看2290，届时减仓一半；第二目标看2320，剩余仓位分批退出。入场后若跌回2247下方并持续不能收复，止损平仓；即使未触及止损，若ETF最终数据继续显著流出且宏观风险偏好恶化，也主动全部平仓。条件未触发就保持空仓，不把计划写成成交。

二、以太坊ETH市场深度分析：弱势格局延续，关注支撑位有效性

二〇二六年十一月六日，以太坊现货价格报两千两百二十八美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之一点五五，跌幅大于比特币。在当前市场环境下，ETH面临来自宏观压力、机构赎回和链上数据走弱的多重挑战，需要投资者保持高度警惕。

一、价格走势分析

从最近五个小时的一小时K线来看，ETH在两千两百一十美元至两千两百四十八美元区间内窄幅震荡。价格从两千两百三十九美元开盘后逐步下行至两千两百一十八美元的日内低点，随后在两千两百一十美元获得支撑并反弹至两千两百三十六美元，最终收于两千两百三十五美元附近。整体波动幅度约为三十美元，振幅约百分之一点三五，显示市场处于缩量盘整状态。

布林带指标显示，上轨为两千两百四十七美元，中轨为两千两百三十五美元，下轨为两千两百二十三美元。价格恰好运行在中轨附近，带宽仅约二十四美元，为近期最窄水平，预示大幅波动即将到来。抛物线SAR指标位于两千两百四十九美元，处于价格上方形成短期压力。超级趋势线在两千两百八十三美元，构成更强的中期阻力。

成交量方面，过去五小时的USDT计价成交量分别为两千七百二十四万美元、三千三百五十三万美元、四千四百二十二万美元、一千八百三十八万美元和一百四十九万美元。第三小时出现放量反弹，对应价格从两千两百一十美元回升至两千两百三十美元，但随后量能迅速萎缩至不足两百万美元，说明市场参与热情不高，观望情绪浓厚。

二、技术指标解读

移动平均线方面，七小时均线为两千两百三十五美元，二十五小时均线为两千两百三十八美元，九十九小时均线为两千三百零二美元。短期均线已经开始向下收敛，长期均线在高位形成明显压制。指数移动平均线同样呈现空头排列，EMA七为两千两百三十五美元，EMA二十五为两千两百五十五美元，EMA九十九为两千两百九十四美元。价格运行在所有均线下方，且与长期均线的偏离度约百分之二点八，表明中期下行趋势尚未扭转。

MACD指标显示，DIF线为负十九点三四，DEA线为负二十四点六三，柱状图为五点二九且连续五个周期保持正值并稳步扩大。与BTC类似，ETH的MACD柱状图也在持续改善，空头动能逐步衰减，但DIF和DEA均处于零轴下方较深位置，反转信号尚需进一步确认。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI为四十八点零一，十二周期RSI为三十八点三七，二十四周期RSI为三十八点四七。短周期RSI回升至五十下方附近，中长期RSI仍处于偏弱区域。值得注意的是，此前六周期RSI一度跌至三十四点四三的接近超卖水平，触发了技术性反弹，但目前反弹动能已有所减弱。

KDJ指标显示K值为五十九点一零，D值为五十八点六四，J值为六十点零一，三线粘合走平，方向不明。随机RSI为八十六点八五，其均线为七十五点七八，短期已进入偏强区域但尚未达到极端超买。

综合因子统计显示，十五个交易因子中有八个发出做多信号，六个发出做空信号，一个中性，做多比例为百分之五十三点三三，与BTC一致。但复合指标值仅为零点一一，做多信号非常微弱，历史胜率高达百分之七十六点六，但平均最大回报仅百分之零点六，显示当前信号的盈利空间有限。

三、市场情绪分析

宏观环境与BTC分析中所述一致，强劲的非农数据和民主党赢得国会导致风险资产普遍承压。ETH additionally面临来自自身基本面的压力。

机构资金流向方面，以太坊现货ETF在十一月五日录得约一亿美元净流出，延续了过去数周的持续赎回趋势。以太坊ETF净资产规模从两百四十一亿美元下降至两百二十二亿美元，机构投资者的信心明显不足。

链上数据方面，以太坊主网质押队列缩减至约一百零四万枚ETH，质押锁仓速度放缓，反映出持有者对长期收益的预期下降。这对ETH的供需平衡构成不利影响，因为质押锁仓是减少流通供应的重要机制。

技术面总结来看，ETH整体弱于BTC，价格运行在所有主要均线下方，MACD虽有改善但信号微弱。两千两百一十美元为短期关键支撑，若跌破则可能下探两千一百美元整数关口；上方两千两百五十美元至两千两百八十三美元为阻力密集区。在机构持续赎回和宏观逆风的双重压力下，ETH短期内反弹空间有限，建议投资者谨慎对待，严格控制风险敞口。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their gains in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day adds up to 12x over 250 trading days a year; a steady 10% a month
adds up to 30x over three years. It may not sound exciting, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities have to be waited for; discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “double my money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former comes from the market;
the ability behind the latter is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital get to keep playing.

How exactly is the total value locked (TVL) often mentioned in the news calculated?
The same assets can be counted more than once: deposit assets into Protocol A to receive a receipt token, then deposit that token into Protocol B, and both protocols will include it in their TVL.
Here’s the key point: a high TVL doesn’t mean a protocol is safer. Protocols with more funds can also be more attractive targets for hackers.
Coin in this example: $ETH  is quoted at 2236.62 (24h -1.38%).
Size your positions according to your means, and leave yourself plenty of room to maneuver.

U.S. jobs data beat expectations, and a rebound in U.S. stocks lifted semiconductor shares—but Bitcoin failed to benefit.

The U.S. October jobs report blew past expectations, with the unemployment rate hitting a new low and wage growth exceeding forecasts. Wall Street expected it to spark a stock market rally. The Nasdaq rose 2%, and the chip ETF jumped 6.5%. But Bitcoin seemed forgotten, trading sideways near $75,764 and slipping slightly. - Short term: Such strong jobs data should theoretically strengthen expectations of Fed rate hikes, putting pressure on high-risk assets like Bitcoin. Meanwhile, chip stocks have surged so sharply that funds may be flowing out of other sectors, such as crypto, which took a beating last week. South Korea is one of the world’s most active crypto trading markets; local funds pulling out could add selling pressure on BTC.
- Medium term: If U.S. stocks remain strong, Bitcoin may need more powerful catalysts to break through resistance at $77,000. But as long as jobs data stays strong, the dollar will strengthen, and Bitcoin’s next move higher will depend on whether a new narrative emerges.

📰 Strive just said Bitcoin returns had surged to 63.2%, and now profits have jumped another 509M: Are crypto stocks riding a wave or caught up in a lasting frenzy?

Strive, a Bitcoin treasury company, was just said to be making a fortune a couple of days ago, and now it has raked in $50.9 billion in profits in the third quarter. Where did all that money come from? Bitcoin itself surged in value. Even more striking, the company is still buying Bitcoin aggressively: since September, it has already bought 15,000 BTC. Its stock has risen more than 500% this year, suggesting the market is extremely bullish on these asset-hoarding, profit-making companies.

Why does this news matter?
Strive's results send two key signals. First, big money is genuinely willing to make long-term bets on Bitcoin with real capital, rather than just speculate on the idea. Second, these Bitcoin treasury companies have become an “anchor” for the crypto market because they have a clear path to buying Bitcoin: when profits grow, they buy more instead of selling off their Bitcoin. That's far more reliable than the mood swings of small retail investors.

Market impact
In the short term, continued buying by major institutions like Strive could boost sentiment around Bitcoin. But the more far-reaching impact is that it makes more traditional institutions think, “Oh, so Bitcoin really can be this profitable.” Just like the approval of Bitcoin ETFs in 2024, the results of these treasury companies are another signal of approval—another way of “voting with money.” This means Bitcoin's institutional adoption could be happening even faster than we think.

How to approach it
The more treasury companies like Strive keep buying Bitcoin, the more Bitcoin looks like an “asset class” rather than a “stock.” This means that as long as Bitcoin doesn't fall to a level where nobody wants it, these companies will keep pushing up its “fair value.” If Bitcoin can stay above $73K, the profit-making effect for companies like Strive will continue to build, attracting more buyers. If it falls below $70K, that effect will be disrupted.

Strive这个比特币财库公司，前两天刚被说赚疯了，现在第三季度又狂揽了509亿美元利润。这钱哪来的？就是比特币本身暴涨带来的。更狠的是，他们还在拼命买币，9月以来已经买了1.5万枚比特币。这家公司股价今年涨了超500%，看来市场极度看好这类囤币玩赚的资产。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Strive的业绩释放了两个关键信号：第一，大钱真的愿意真金白银长期押注比特币，而不是炒概念。第二，这种比特币财库公司成了加密市场的"定海神针"，因为它们有明确买币路径——利润多了就买，不买光自己的比特币。这比小散户的情绪波动可靠多了。

对市场的影响
短期内看，Strive这种大机构持续买入，会推高比特币情绪水位。但更深远的影响是，它让更多传统机构觉得"哦，原来比特币能这么赚钱"。就像2024年比特币ETF获批一样，这类财库公司的业绩是另一类"用钱投票"的认可信号。这意味着比特币的机构化进程，可能比我们想象的还要快。

操作思路
Strive这种持续买币的财库公司越多，比特币就越像"类资产"而不是"类股"。这意味着只要比特币价格没到天荒地老没人要的地步，这类公司就会继续推高比特币的"合理估值"。如果比特币能维持在$73K以上，Strive这种公司的赚钱效应就会持续发酵，从而吸引更多买盘。如果跌破$70K，这种赚钱效应就会被打断。

Posts calling for 2600 keep piling up, but the money willing to pay rent for 2600 has already pulled out.

ETH is currently at 2233.39, down 1.87% in 24 hours—not much of a drop. But the 8-hour funding rate is +0.0033%, less than a third of the 0.01% baseline rate. The price is down less than two percent, while the cost of holding a position has fallen by nearly seventy percent. That asymmetry tells us far more than the drop itself.

First, look at the funding rate. In perpetual markets, funding is essentially rent: longs pay shorts to buy the “I’m bullish” position. When prices dip slightly, longs usually react in one of two ways: hold on and keep renewing their lease at close to the full rate, or close their positions and leave. The rate falling from full to a third suggests the second—and that leveraged traders were the first to go. The remaining longs haven’t suddenly become more cautious; they simply don’t have positions left to pay for. You can read the so-called “retreat of leveraged longs” right in the funding rate, without even looking at the price.

Next, consider the figure showing that 79.7% of accounts are long. This counts the number of accounts, not the size of their margin. Nearly eight out of ten accounts are long, yet the funding rate is only a third of its baseline. Put those two figures together and they point to one conclusion: the bullish traders are small accounts. The capital that actually determines the price has either already left or isn’t in perpetual contracts to begin with. So posts on the feed saying things like “epic surge tonight” and “insider news says we’re flying to 2600” don’t contradict the pricing in the order book: the people posting and the people setting prices aren’t the same crowd. A crowd of longs by account count and a crowd of longs by capital are two different things.

The third dimension is turnover. 24-hour trading volume is 9.317 billion USDT, against open interest of 5.296 billion USDT. The market has turned over nearly 1.8 times in a day, yet the price has moved only 1.87%. This is turnover with buyers stepping in, not the pattern of a one-way liquidation cascade. When the market can neither fall nor rally, it’s usually waiting on an external variable—not waiting on itself.

That external variable is already in view. BTC around 76,150 has just been swept by the wave of selling triggered by AI, with more than $1 billion in liquidations, while employment data is still pending. In this structure, ETH is a high-beta follower, not a price setter. Until the data comes out, the funding rate will most likely keep moving toward zero rather than bouncing back.

So my view is this: at 2233, the issue isn’t direction—it’s positioning. The funding rate is the one quote in perpetual markets that doesn’t lie. Its fall from full to a third means that longs in this round are no longer willing to keep paying for the 2600 story.

Two concrete ideas for trading: if you want to go long, wait for the 8-hour funding rate to climb back above 0.007%. That would show new leveraged capital is willing to pay to enter, which is more reliable than any insider tip. If you want to go short, don’t chase after the funding rate has already collapsed. Carry here is already painfully thin; you’d be betting on direction while paying for time. 📉

A single 8-hour settlement can rewrite all the readings above. Don’t bet on a price from someone else’s post with a position you can’t hold through two settlements.

content:
喊 2600 的帖子还在增加，愿意为 2600 付租金的钱已经撤了。

ETH 现价 2233.39，24 小时跌 1.87%，跌幅不算什么；但 8 小时资金费率报 +0.0033%，不到 0.01% 基准费率的三分之一。价格掉了不到两个点，持仓成本掉了将近七成，这个不对称比跌幅本身信息量大得多。

先看费率这一层。永续市场的资金费率本质是租金，多头向空头付钱买“我看涨”这个位置。价格小跌的时候，多头通常有两种反应：继续扛、继续按接近满额的价格续租；或者平仓走人。费率从满额掉到三分之一，说明走的是第二种，而且是带杠杆的那批先走。剩下的多头不是突然变谨慎了，是没仓位可付了。所谓“杠杆多头撤退”，不看价格也能从费率读数里读出来。

再看多头账户占比 79.7% 这个数。它统计的是账户数量，不是保证金规模。接近八成的账户在做多，费率却只有基准的三分之一，两个数放在一起只指向一个结论：看多的那批人是小账户。真正决定价格的那部分资金，要么已经离场，要么压根不在永续合约里。所以广场上“今晚史诗级暴涨、小道消息飞 2600”这类帖子，和盘口的定价并不矛盾：发帖的人和定价的人不是同一批。人头上的多头拥挤，和资金上的多头拥挤，是两件事。

第三个维度看换手。24 小时成交额 93.17 亿 USDT，对应持仓量 52.96 亿 USDT，一天换了接近 1.8 遍手，价格却只挪了 1.87%。这是有承接的换手，不是单边踩踏的形态。跌不动、也拉不动的横盘，通常不是在等自己，是在等外部变量。

外部变量已经摆在那了。BTC 在 76,150 附近刚被 AI 带崩的那波抛售扫过一遍，清算规模超过 10 亿美元，而就业数据还没落地。ETH 在这个结构里是高 beta 的跟随者，不是定价者。数据出来之前，费率大概率继续往 0 靠，而不是往回弹。

所以我的判断是：2233 这个位置现在不是方向问题，是仓位问题。费率是永续市场唯一不说谎的报价，它从满额掉到三分之一，意思就是这轮多头已经不愿意为 2600 这个故事续费了。

操作上给两句具体的：想做多，等 8 小时费率重新站回 0.007% 以上，那说明新的杠杆资金愿意付钱进场，比任何小道消息都可靠；想做空，别在费率已经趴下去的地方追，这里的 carry 已经薄得可怜，你赌的是方向，付的是时间。📉

一次 8 小时结算就能把上面所有读数改写，别用扛不过两次结算的仓位去赌一个别人帖子里的价格。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Lying to You When You Hold a Losing Position
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on a position focus on? The “all-time high,” thinking, “If it just gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Pay attention: this thought is all attachment and no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand in the here and now.

Once you decide to hold a losing position, you automatically seek out bullish news and block out bearish news. This is called confirmation bias. You start to think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned through more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to put into practice: before opening a position, write down “under what conditions the logic behind this trade
fails,” then act when those conditions are met, regardless of how you feel. Separate decision-making from holding the position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

Anchorage Digital has applied to the U.S. CFTC to become a crypto options market maker. If approved, it will offer BTC and ETH options, with implications for the direction of industry regulation.

Anchorage Digital has submitted an application to register with the CFTC as a swap dealer, seeking to legally offer Bitcoin and Ethereum options in the U.S. If approved, this would bring crypto derivatives one step closer to the regulatory mainstream in the U.S., and they might eventually operate more like options markets in Europe and the U.S. For now, these derivatives remain in a gray area in the U.S. and are traded mainly over the counter. The application sends a signal that regulators want to bring these instruments into the regulatory framework, too.

Market impact
- Short term: The news itself won't directly push BTC or ETH higher, but it may make some investors seeking to avoid regulatory risk feel that “regulation is tightening,” potentially prompting them to exit in the short term. 🎯 BTC and ETH will most likely continue trading within a range for now, since CFTC approval takes time and the application has only just been submitted.
- Medium term: If approved, this application would be a major positive for the crypto derivatives market as a whole. Futures and options make it easier for institutions to hedge risk or pursue arbitrage, potentially attracting more traditional capital. For BTC and ETH specifically, however, the impact is less clear for now. It will largely depend on whether institutions see improved regulation as a reason to start building positions, or increased risk as a reason to stay away.

My take
This news is fairly neutral—just an industry development. Regulatory involvement will gradually make the crypto market more transparent, but it won't directly change prices in the short term. BTC's recent support is around $70K, while ETH is below $2K. For a real trend to emerge, we'll need to see how this application progresses. translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn’t Admitting You’re Wrong—it’s the Price of Admission for Your Next Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to place a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
can’t take it. Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I’ve ever met are quicker than anyone to cut their losses when they’re wrong. Because they know: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. Next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself:
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

A few Ethereum projects would become vulnerable under Glamsterdam's proposed rules, the Ethereum Foundation said in its November 6 update. ChainSecurity found the issues during testnet testing of the upgrade.

The Foundation is engaging ChainSecurity and Dedaub alongside internal audits, and asking developers and auditors across Ethereum to check their projects. Its own review cannot cover every application, including the off-chain code those applications depend on.

One risk shows how a change in gas accounting can affect what users can recover from. ChainSecurity describes contracts where an unsuccessful operation can currently be tried again because the whole attempt rolls back. Under the proposed rules, some of those contracts could instead record a permanent failure, closing that retry path even though their code has not changed. This concerns how applications handle failed contract calls, not every failed wallet transaction.

The November 6 update names no affected projects and reports no live exploit. Hoodi's testnet upgrade remains on hold until the issues are resolved.

The open question is how widely existing applications depend on assumptions the upgrade would break. The Foundation wants that evidence for upcoming AllCoreDev discussions, including whether changes to the upgrade specifications could prevent the problems.

Sources: Ethereum Foundation, November 6; ChainSecurity's analysis of the October 13 specifications.

In a nutshell
Strive’s crypto stock generated $475 million in Q3, mainly thanks to strong Bitcoin yields—but the risks are extremely high when markets are volatile.

What happened
Strive’s earnings report showed third-quarter net income of $475 million and a net profit margin of over 35%. The key factor was its year-to-date Bitcoin yield of 63.2%, far above the industry average. This was thanks to Strive’s large Bitcoin holdings, which serve both as an investment and as a source of passive income. But the report also warned that this model directly ties the company’s performance to Bitcoin’s price: when Bitcoin rises, income increases; when it falls, losses may follow.

Market impact
- Short term: Crypto stocks like Strive will attract more investor attention because their yield figures look impressive. But if Bitcoin continues to fall, these stocks could face a wave of selling, since their returns are highly sensitive to price movements.
- Medium term: This could lead to greater divergence in the crypto stock market. Crypto stocks that can diversify their revenue sources (for example, those involved in DeFi or GameFi) are more resilient. Stocks that rely solely on Bitcoin yields may come under valuation pressure.

My take
The high-yield Bitcoin model reflected in Strive’s report is a double-edged sword for the crypto stock market as a whole. Freezing is not the end point, but the starting point for layered interception. Regarding the assets stolen from Binance, my view is that how quickly the losses can be contained depends more on whether issuers, on-chain analytics firms, L2s, and DeFi protocols can coordinate their interceptions within the same time window than on the scale of any single institution’s freeze. This view assumes that the funds remain in freezeable stablecoins or at addresses from which they can be removed through governance.

According to a compilation by Odaily Planet Daily, Tether cooperated in freezing more than 1.567 billion USDT, while Circle froze over $800 million in USDC, bringing the combined total to more than $2.3 billion. The FBI attributed the incident to a North Korean hacking group and published more than 600 Ethereum addresses, nearly 20 Bitcoin addresses, and one Solana address. Arbitrum’s Security Council transferred approximately 8,426 ETH and 74.56 million ARB to an intermediary freeze address, while around 44 million OP was removed from the attacker’s address on Optimism. Aave, meanwhile, preemptively froze some V3 and V4 markets, suspending new deposits and borrowing. These facts show that interception is layered: stablecoin issuers halt transfers, L2 governance moves assets directly, and DeFi protocols block paths to leverage.

From this, I infer that what truly determines whether losses can be contained is whether each layer is willing and able to coordinate quickly. Tether’s freeze only blocks USDT transfers out; it does not mean Binance has recovered the funds. ETH already borrowed from Aave remains under the attacker’s control. My observation is that a large amount frozen does not necessarily mean a high recovery rate; subsequent return procedures and interception of cross-chain swaps are the key variables.

Conditions to monitor include whether balances at stolen addresses continue to fall, whether the amount of frozen stablecoins increases, and whether related trades appear on exchange channels such as THORChain. If the hackers convert the funds into assets that are harder to freeze or disperse them across chains, the force of the above assessment will weaken. 据Odaily星球日报整理，Tether配合冻结逾15.67亿枚USDT，Circle冻结逾8亿美元USDC，两家合计逾23亿美元；FBI将事件归因于朝鲜黑客组织，并公布600多个以太坊地址、近20个比特币地址和1个Solana地址；Arbitrum安全委员会将约8426枚ETH和约7456万枚ARB转至中间冻结地址，Optimism侧约4400万枚OP被移出攻击者地址。Aave则预防性冻结V3、V4部分市场，暂停新存款和新借款。这些事实说明拦截是分层的：稳定币发行方截断转账，L2治理直接移动资产，DeFi协议阻断加杠杆路径。

据此推断，真正决定损失能否收敛的，是各层是否愿意且能够快速配合。Tether冻结只截断USDT转出，不等于币安已拿回资金；Aave已借出的ETH仍在攻击者控制下。我的观察是，冻结规模大不等于追回比例高，后续返还流程和跨链兑换拦截才是关键变量。

需要跟踪的验证条件包括：被盗地址余额是否继续下降、稳定币冻结规模是否扩大、THORChain等兑换渠道是否出现相关成交。若黑客将资金转为难冻结资产或跨链分散，上述判断的效力会减弱。本文不构成投资建议。

Technical principles | What exactly is the EVM, and what does “EVM-compatible” mean?
The EVM is a stack-based virtual machine. Each data unit (word) is 256 bits, and the stack has a maximum depth of 1024.
The EVM charges Gas for each instruction. Once a transaction runs out of Gas, it is aborted and its state changes are reverted, preventing infinite loops from clogging the entire network.
When you call a contract on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for every instruction it executes, paid with $ETH .
Be cautious when you come across projects claiming to offer high returns.

#ETH

title: Bitcoin vs. Ethereum: Understanding Two Different Ideas Behind Crypto 🪙
subTitle:
Bitcoin and Ethereum are frequently discussed together, but understanding their differences is essential for anyone interested in blockchain technology.
Both projects are important in the cryptocurrency ecosystem, yet they were designed around different goals.
Instead of asking which one is better, a more useful question is:
What problem is each network trying to solve?
1. Bitcoin: A Decentralized Monetary Network
Bitcoin ($BTC) introduced a way to transfer value through a decentralized network without requiring a traditional central authority to approve every transaction.
Its design emphasizes:
- Decentralization.
- Security.
- Transparency.
- A predictable monetary issuance schedule.
- Resistance to centralized control.
Bitcoin's relatively focused design is one reason many people view it primarily through the lens of digital money and a potential store of value.
2. Ethereum: A Programmable Blockchain
Ethereum ($ETH) introduced a broader concept: a blockchain that can execute smart contracts.
Smart contracts are programs that run on a blockchain when their conditions are met.
This allows developers to create applications such as:
- Decentralized exchanges.
- Lending protocols.
- Digital collectibles.
- Blockchain-based games.
- Tokenized applications.
- Decentralized autonomous organizations.
Ethereum is therefore not only a network for transferring value. It also provides infrastructure for developers to build applications.
3. The Difference Is About Purpose
Think of Bitcoin as a network designed around decentralized digital value.
Think of Ethereum as a programmable environment where developers can build applications that interact with digital assets.
This distinction helps explain why their ecosystems look different.
Bitcoin's central narrative is strongly connected to monetary properties and decentralization.
Ethereum's ecosystem is more closely associated with smart contracts, decentralized applications, and programmable financial infrastructure.
4. Different Risks and Challenges
Neither network is free from challenges.
Bitcoin faces discussions around scalability, transaction costs, and the long-term economics of network security.
Ethereum faces questions around scalability, network complexity, transaction costs, and the risks associated with applications built on top of it.
There are also risks outside the blockchain itself, including exchange failures, wallet security problems, phishing attacks, and regulatory uncertainty.
5. Why Understanding Both Matters
The cryptocurrency ecosystem is not a competition involving only one winner.
Different networks can serve different purposes and attract different users.
A person interested in monetary decentralization may focus more on Bitcoin.
A developer building decentralized applications may pay closer attention to Ethereum.
The important thing is to understand the technology instead of following market narratives without investigating them.
Final Thoughts
Bitcoin and Ethereum helped establish two influential directions in blockchain development.
One emphasizes decentralized monetary infrastructure, while the other expands the possibilities of programmable blockchain applications.
Understanding their different purposes gives us a better foundation for evaluating the wider crypto ecosystem.
Discussion Question: Do you think the future of blockchain will be dominated by a few major networks, or will specialized blockchains coexist for different purposes?
Disclaimer: This article is educational and does not recommend buying, selling, or holding any cryptocurrency.

My stance is to stick to discipline for now and not treat a single rebound as evidence that money is flowing back into ETH. Farside currently lists total net outflows of $99.9 million from U.S. spot Ethereum funds on November 5, including outflows of $75.2 million from one fund and $22 million from another. The individual product columns for November 6 still show dashes, while the 0.0 in the total column is a placeholder pending an update. It should not be reported as zero outflows today, much less as a confirmed shift to inflows. These figures are estimates of fund subscriptions and redemptions; they do not represent all spot ETH trading.

On the macro front, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported on November 6 that nonfarm payrolls rose by 165,000 in October, the unemployment rate was 4.1%, and average hourly earnings increased 0.4% month over month. Employment figures for the previous two months were revised up by a combined 84,000. The labor market remains resilient, and wage growth offers no clear assurance that interest rates will fall quickly. The transmission channel to ETH is through expectations for dollar interest rates and risk appetite: if real rates remain high, investors may demand greater compensation for risk, making spot-market support especially important during a run of fund outflows. Conversely, if rate expectations ease and funds shift from outflows to sustained inflows, we shouldn’t cling stubbornly to a bearish narrative. The employment report is a fact; the future path of rate cuts is only a market expectation. The two should not be conflated.

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,224, below the daily open of $2,235. It traded in a range of $2,211 to $2,247 during the day. The price has not confirmed a breakout above the upper end of the range since the report was released, and we can’t attribute the entire day’s volatility to this report. I’m watching $2,211 and $2,202 below, and $2,235 followed by $2,247 above. The $2,247 level is near the intraday high; it is not guaranteed to act as support. A cautious bullish shift would be justified only if ETH regains $2,247 and holds it on a retest, while upcoming fund data also shows no further widening of outflows. If it loses $2,211 and then breaks below $2,202, the short-term recovery thesis is invalidated. Today’s fund data has not yet been fully released, so for now I’ll watch whether price and volume confirm each other rather than using yesterday’s figures to explain every intraday move.

If I were trading this myself, I’d currently be watching from the sidelines with 0% of my portfolio invested. I wouldn’t use leverage or place a buy order ahead of a breakout. I’d consider going long only if spot ETH breaks above $2,247, closes at least one hour above that level, and then holds the $2,240–$2,247 range on a retest. My initial position would be no more than 0.8% of total capital. If price only briefly spikes above the range and then falls back, I’d stay out. After entering, I’d first watch $2,270 and sell half the position there; I’d target $2,300 for the remainder, but would also reduce the position proactively if price rises on weak volume. I’d set a hard stop below $2,220. If the market breaks below $2,211 first, I’d cancel the long trade plan outright. If, after entry, price falls back below $2,235 and fails to reclaim it within an hour, I’d close early rather than wait for the hard stop. If fund outflows remain significant and rate expectations rise, I’d reduce the position or close it entirely even if price briefly rallies. This is a conditional plan, not a report of trades executed or profits made.

#ETH
The above is only my personal market commentary and does not constitute investment advice.

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Position Compounding: Fortune Through Risk, or an Accelerator to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Position compounding has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: start with a small amount of capital, use several times leverage to ride a big trend, and after compounding a few times,
turn it into dozens of times your original stake. Today, let’s talk about what those stories leave out.

【How Position Compounding Works】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for new positions and keep opening trades,
It’s basically using the market’s money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, the compounding is incredible; when it stops, unrealized gains can go from
up dozens of percentage points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The Mathematical Truth】Position compounding is essentially about “being right repeatedly.” If you have a 60% chance of winning each time, the odds of winning four times in a row
are only 13%. Behind every post you see about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Winning Trend Trade Without Getting Burned
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve correctly identified the trend and want to add to your position. How should you do it? Going in big right away and adding until you’re fully invested with unrealized gains is a recipe for landing on the liquidation list.
It happens all the time. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Add less each time than you did the previous time. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first pullback is confirmed,
After confirmation, add another 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be. This keeps most of your cost basis low, so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the opposite is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, then adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn your profits into losses. Once you lose your nerve, your whole strategy falls apart.

title: 五个币同时创月内新低，这点反抽凭什么算反弹？
subTitle:
这个点还留着仓位的人，纠结的其实是同一件事：账面上的亏损已经摆在那里，可最近四个小时是绿的，在这根绿线前离场，还是再扛一个晚上。把十个币的24小时、12小时、4小时三段涨跌并排放好，这个纠结有答案，只是答案不太舒服。今天九个币收跌，跌幅从2.07%到9.09%，只有一个收正。

先说权重最大的两个。比特币现价75940.35美元，24小时跌4.64%，而它的24小时低点75208.42同时是7日低点与30日低点，等于今天把月内低点重新打了一遍，现价离这个低点不到1%。它下方92美元就是布林下轨75116，30日区间分位只剩7.6%，RSI 38.1，三条都指向同一侧。以太坊跌6.26%，比比特币更重，可近四小时是0.00，一动不动，12小时也只跌0.26%，空头在这里第一次收手。更别扭的是它的MACD柱状值是正1.7836，十个币里只有它和TON是正的。指标转了正，四个小时却一分钱没涨，这算转向还是算僵持，只能等下一段数据回答。

第二个对照更能说明问题。BNB 24小时只跌2.07%，是九个下跌币里最轻的，距MA25只差3.78%，是全场离中期均线最近的一个；成交仅为7日均量的0.45倍，跌得少不是因为有人接，是因为没人再卖。SOL 走的是另一条路：价格90.45，24小时跌5.17%，24小时低点88.3既是7日低点也是30日低点，还几乎就是布林下轨88.2879，两者只差0.0121美元。它的RSI 31.6是十个币里最低的，30日分位7.5%倒数第二，距MA25还有9.71%的距离。就贴着下轨，四个小时却只反弹0.41%，这种位置要么弹得很快，要么直接穿下去，横在中间最难受。

第三个对照是今天真正的伤口。$XRP 24小时跌9.09%排第一，12小时再跌2.39%，4小时跌0.75%，三段全跌，没有一段出现过修复。它的量能0.79倍是十个币里最活跃的，价格1.1882已经落到布林下轨1.1983下方，布林位置是负5.8%；30日分位4.2%，紧贴区间最底部；24小时低点1.1776同样是7日与30日低点。跌得最狠、量放得最大、位置最靠下，三个条件叠在一起，说明这里的卖压是真实的，不是流动性空档造成的假摔。狗狗币跌4.56%，量能0.54倍，布林位置7.4%，24小时低点0.0702也创了月内新低，可它12小时涨0.57%、4小时涨0.25%，跌幅被吃回去一部分。同样是把月内低点重打一遍，一个在放量往下砸，一个在缩量往上磨，性质并不一样。

第四个对照看反弹的成色。艾达币24小时跌4.10%，12小时却涨1.08%，是十个币里12小时最强的，4小时再涨0.59%，代价是距MA25差10.09%，离中期均线最远。雪崩跌3.58%，12小时涨0.94%、4小时涨0.47%，布林位置22.9%在除TON之外最高，量能却只有0.33倍。两个都是跌完就弹的形态，幅度在，成交的支撑不在。

最后两个位置上最靠前。$LINK 24小时跌4.60%看着平平，但4小时涨0.74%是全场最强，30日分位19.7%在十个币里排第一，RSI 41.1处于中性偏下；关键在它距30日低点10.273还有2.30%的空间，是少数没有把月内低点重新打穿的币。跌幅不小、位置不低、还能在最近四小时领涨，三件事放一起，说明它的筹码比其余九个稳一些。只是量能0.32倍，这种稳是卖盘撤走的稳，不是买盘进来的稳。TON 是另一回事：24小时涨0.95%，十个币里只有它收正，可4小时跌0.99%全场最弱，12小时跌0.56%，最近半天在往回吐；成交只有770万美元，量能0.05倍。它站在MA7上方1.18%，布林位置33.2%与RSI 44.5都是十币最高，但一个几乎没有成交的盘口上，好看的指标不具备参考价值。

五组摆完，那个“凭什么”仍然没有解决。反弹的这四个小时里，十个币的量能全部低于7日均量，最高的瑞波0.79倍还在跌；五个币在今天创出月内新低；十个币没有一个站在MA99上方。三件事指向同一种状态：卖压暂时用尽，买盘还没接力。隔夜的风险点也很具体，比特币75208.42与布林下轨75116之间只有92美元的空隙，亚盘只要往下试一次，这两个位置会一起失守，再往下就没有30日区间内的参照了。反过来，如果亚盘能把比特币推回到MA7 77534附近，今晚这根绿线才算有点分量。

$SOL 这边还多一层分歧。它的24小时低点是月内新低，价格却已经回到下轨上方2.45%，RSI 31.6处在超卖边缘，按常规该有一段修复；可量能0.52倍，修复缺少资金确认。修复和破位两种走法都说得通，这也是看不准的地方。

真正看不准的是以太坊。MACD柱已经转正，四个小时却零涨跌，量能0.54倍不好不坏，这种状态既可能是下跌末端的停顿，也可能是下一段下跌前的换手，单看今晚的数据分不出来，得等它能不能站上MA7 2279.96才能定性。所有这些位置一小时一变，写下的数字到亚盘可能已经作废，照着数字进出的人，最好先想好自己的退路在哪里。

$ETH: What Does a Helpful Crypto Post Owe Its Reader?: While the Evidence Develops

A fair dilemma sits at the heart of public analysis: we want to help, yet every word also shapes belief. For $ETH, price sits at 2231.7, the hourly direction is down, and volume runs above baseline. Those are observations, not verdicts. A writer can report them plainly, or wrap them in urgency that nudges action before the reader has weighed alternatives. The first approach respects uncertainty; the second trades it for attention. Reasonable readers may disagree because each person balances speed against caution differently. One may see a dip as value, another as risk, and both can be right until more data arrives. A transparent way to discuss uncertainty is to separate what is known from what is guessed. Known: $ETH moved -0.398993 in the last hour, its RSI reads 46.8497, and it trades inside its recorded range. Guessed: whether that range will hold or break. To reassess, ask which guess would be falsified by the next hourly candle and at what price. If the answer is clear, the claim is testable; if not, label it opinion. Treat social proof as a clue, not proof. High volume can reflect excitement, but it also amplifies noise. Ask what the crowd might be missing before echoing it. Write to Earn programs create a parallel dilemma: they reward output, not accuracy. That incentive can push toward confident statements that age poorly. The ethical move is to flag the conflict, keep rewards separate from analysis, and invite disagreement without baiting replies. Helpful posts owe the reader a way to update their mind, not just a reason to act.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

What makes a crypto post helpful rather than merely persuasive?

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Have to Stay in the Game to Last
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been talked to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U per trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
Your account is only down 20%; a few winning trades can make that back. By contrast, if you go all-in each time and lose 30%,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You'd need to nearly double it to break even—mathematically, you're basically out of the game.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
must not exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work out the position size.

What exactly is the EVM, and what does “EVM-compatible” mean?
BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche’s C-Chain, and many Layer 2 networks are EVM-compatible, so Ethereum wallets and development tools can usually be used directly.
Once a contract is deployed, its bytecode is fixed and anyone can inspect it. Whether its source code is available depends on whether the developer has verified it on a block explorer.
When calling a contract on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for each instruction it executes, paid with $ETH .
Every potential return comes with a corresponding risk, so think about the worst-case scenario first.

#ETH

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Scaling out: How to lock in profits while letting them run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because a stop-loss cuts fear, while taking profits cuts greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scaling-out strategy I've been using.

【Three-stage approach】Stage one: when the price reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 risk-reward ratio), reduce your position by 1/3 and lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade is no longer at risk of losing money, and your mindset changes immediately. Stage two: at the second target
(for example, a 2:1 risk-reward ratio), reduce your position by another 1/3. Stage three: let the rest ride with a trailing stop; exit if the price falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run. 

【Why this works】If you exit your entire position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you often end up riding the elevator back to square one.

It took me a long time to stop seeing the words “stop loss” as an admission of defeat.

It doesn’t predict where the market will go. It simply acknowledges something in advance: I could be wrong.

There’s no need to prove that I’m wrong; it’s already a possibility.

So that loss wasn’t proof of failure—it was the price of entering the trade.

What really breaks you isn’t a stop loss. It’s having no stop loss, so that one mistake takes many later wins to make up for.

Now, before I place an order, I think through one thing first: how much can I lose on this trade and still sleep at night?

A question: What exactly is ERC-20?
The decimals field in ERC-20 specifies how many decimal places a token can be divided into. Many tokens use 18 decimal places, while some use only 6.
Token balances aren’t stored in wallets; they’re recorded in the token contract’s own ledger, and wallets simply display those records.
Don’t send tokens directly to the contract address of that token. Most of these contracts don’t have a function for sending tokens out, so tokens sent there often can’t be recovered.
ERC-20 tokens run on Ethereum, and each transfer requires $ETH  to pay for Gas. Current amount: 2237.93.

What exactly is the EVM, and what does “EVM-compatible” mean? Many people can’t answer!
EVM execution must be deterministic: the same inputs must produce the same results on every node, or nodes cannot reach consensus.
The EVM charges Gas for each instruction. Once the Gas provided by a transaction runs out, execution stops and state changes are reverted, preventing infinite loops from holding up the entire network.

📰 Why did the Russian central bank suddenly name BTC, ETH, and USDT?

The Russian central bank just said it might give non-qualified investors the green light to trade crypto, and immediately singled out Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tether as three assets that ordinary people could be allowed to access first. Right after this news broke, the Moscow Exchange also announced that it would launch crypto trading under the new rules on December 1. This could have a significant impact on the crypto market, especially these three coins.

Why is this news important?
Russia is running a pilot program to see whether ordinary people can handle investing in crypto. Naming BTC, ETH, and USDT shows that these are among the market’s mainstream assets, but also that they carry the highest risks. Russian regulation has generally been relatively relaxed, and this latest move is essentially a way to observe how these three coins perform under the new rules and use that as a reference for future policy. In other words, regulators are testing the waters and watching how the market reacts.

Market impact
Sentiment will certainly be affected in the short term, especially for high-risk assets like BTC and ETH. If ordinary Russian investors are willing to participate, the resulting inflows could be substantial. Over the long term, however, expectations of tighter regulation could make it harder for these two coins to see explosive rallies. There have been similar events in the past—for example, when the EU classified crypto assets, the market went through a period of volatility. If Russia’s pilot program goes badly, other countries may become more cautious.

Trading approach
This news is bearish for BTC and ETH, but it’s not a sure thing. If Russia’s pilot program gets a positive response and funds really do flow in, these two coins may still have a chance. But if problems arise and regulators shut it down, the downward pressure could be significant. If strict regulatory measures like those in the United States are introduced, this assessment will no longer apply.

Chainalysis discloses credential leak｜Risk-control services gradually resume｜Don’t trade ETH prices as if this were an on-chain outage

My view is to classify this as an infrastructure risk and not to short ETH on this basis for now. A trending topic on Binance Square reads, “Chainalysis hacked, password hashes and tokens leaked.” I checked the company’s official updates: on the evening of November 4, the company disclosed that attackers obtained the names, usernames, password hashes, and “live tokens” of all users. The KYT interface and API, address screening, and login page were taken offline due to unusual activity, and KYT customers who appeared to have been accessed without authorization were notified. At 03:30 ET on November 6, the company said KYT and address screening had begun to resume in stages. Authorized users must reset their passwords and, where applicable, rotate their API keys. Reactor and Data Solutions are still being restored. This is an incident involving the company’s services, not a breach of Ethereum’s consensus layer, and the word “token” alone does not imply that ETH private keys have been leaked.

Why might this affect the market? Exchanges, custodians, and compliance teams may rely on third-party on-chain screening services to assess transaction risk. A service outage or credential rotation can increase manual verification and operating costs, affecting infrastructure efficiency and trust; it does not automatically change ETH supply. Chainalysis says there is currently no evidence that investigative data was accessed or its address attribution data tampered with; this still needs to be monitored. The Record also cross-checked the subsequent disclosures and phased restoration plans. It is essential to distinguish between “confirmed exposure of hashes and tokens,” “the company has so far found no issues with other data,” and “the type of tokens and the extent of any actual misuse remain unclear.”

The market reaction does not show ETH crashing solely because of this news. Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,241.58 when I wrote this; the daily open was $2,235.09, with an intraday low of $2,210.99 and high of $2,247.28. The rolling 24-hour low was $2,202.12 and high was $2,395.73. The price is only slightly above the daily open and still below the intraday high. This rebound cannot be attributed to the service restoration, and yesterday’s ETF outflows should not be mechanically treated as selling pressure right now. Watch whether $2,247.28 holds, followed by $2,260. To the downside, watch $2,235 and $2,211; only a break below $2,202 would indicate that the basis for the short-term recovery has been significantly damaged. The U.S. employment report, due at 21:30 Beijing time tonight, has not yet been released, and macro volatility could far exceed the direct price impact of this service news.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now, with a 0% spot position, and only consider a conditional long without leverage, capped at 0.8% of total capital. The entry trigger would be for ETH to close an hourly candle above $2,247 at least 15 minutes after the employment report is released, then hold that level on a retest, with no new Chainalysis announcement expanding the scope of the impact. If the risk-control services go down again or the price move is just a brief spike, I would remain flat. The first target is $2,260, where I would sell half; the second target is $2,290, where I would sell most of the remainder and use a trailing stop for the rest. The initial stop is below $2,225; after entry, I would exit immediately if the price falls below $2,211, without averaging down. If the price still cannot hold above $2,247 after two hours, I would exit proactively. Both the incident and the price need verifiable developments before the position is worth opening.

Sources: Chainalysis official security updates, cross-check by The Record, Kraken ETH/USD, Binance Square trending topics. #Chainalysis遭攻击致密码哈希及令牌泄露 #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
Chainalysis披露凭证外泄｜风控服务分批恢复｜ETH价格别按链上故障交易

我的态度是把这件事列为基础设施风险，暂不据此追空ETH。币安广场热榜出现“Chainalysis遭攻击致密码哈希及令牌泄露”。核对官网更新：公司11月4日晚披露，攻击者获取了涉及全部用户的姓名、用户名、密码哈希和“live tokens”；KYT界面和API、地址筛查及登录页因异常活动下线，并通知看似遭未授权访问的KYT客户。官网11月6日美东03:30又称，KYT与地址筛查已开始分批恢复，获准接入的用户须重置密码并按适用情况轮换API密钥；Reactor和Data Solutions仍在恢复中。这是公司服务事件，不是以太坊共识链被攻破，也不能从“令牌”二字推断ETH私钥已经泄露。

为什么会影响市场？交易所、托管机构和合规团队可能依赖第三方链上筛查服务处理交易风险。服务中断或凭证轮换会提高人工核验和运营成本，影响基础设施的效率与信任，不自动造成ETH供应变化。Chainalysis称目前没有证据表明调查数据被访问或其地址归因数据遭篡改；这仍需跟踪。The Record也核对了后续披露和分批恢复安排。必须区分“已确认的哈希与令牌外泄”“公司对其他数据暂未发现问题”及“尚不清楚令牌类型和实际滥用范围”。

市场反应没有显示ETH因这条消息单独崩跌。Kraken ETH/USD写稿约2241.58美元，日开2235.09，日内低2210.99、高2247.28；滚动24小时低2202.12、高2395.73。价格仅略高于日开且仍低于日内高位，不能把这一段反弹归因于服务恢复，也不能把昨日ETF流出机械套成此刻卖盘。重点看2247.28能否站稳，其次是2260；下方看2235与2211，跌破2202才说明短线修复基础被明显破坏。今晚北京时间21:30美国就业报告还未公布，宏观波动可能远大于这项服务消息的直接价格影响。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，现货仓位0%，只考虑无杠杆、最多占总资金0.8%的条件试多。入场触发是就业报告公布至少15分钟后，ETH一小时收盘站上2247且回踩不破，且Chainalysis没有发布新的扩大影响公告；若风控服务再度中断或价格只是一根插针，就保持空仓。首个目标2260，减仓一半；第二目标2290，再减大部分，余仓移动止损。初始止损在2225下方；入场后若跌破2211立即平仓，不摊低成本。若两小时仍无法站稳2247，也主动退出。事件与价格都要有可核实的进展，仓位才值得启动。

The EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine) is the virtual machine that executes Ethereum smart contracts. Every node executes the same contract code according to the same rules.
When interacting with EVM-compatible chains, the addresses look the same, but be sure to check which chain your assets are on.
When calling a contract on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for every instruction it executes, paid in $ETH .

以太坊市场深度分析：ETF资金流出与科技股暴跌双重打击，鲸鱼逢低吸纳显现底部信号

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月六日，以太坊现货价格报二千二百四十二美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之六点二，跌幅大于比特币。价格从二千三百八十七美元的高位快速回落，最低触及二千二百二十三美元，随后在二千二百四十美元附近企稳反弹。

本轮以太坊的下跌受到多重因素压制。首先，以太坊现货ETF出现约一亿美元的单日净流出，机构投资者的撤离加剧了现货市场的抛压。其次，在价格急跌过程中，交易所出现约五千四百八十万美元的大额卖单，导致单小时净流出达到九千七百五十万美元，引发连锁清算。第三，美国科技股的暴跌对以太坊形成情绪传染，纳斯达克指数单日蒸发超过三万亿美元市值，风险偏好急剧下降。

从K线走势来看，过去五根一小时K线呈现探底回升的格局。第一根K线从二千二百二十八美元开盘，下跌至二千二百二十六美元收盘。第二根K线大幅拉升至二千二百三十九美元，显示买盘在低位积极承接。第三根K线小幅回落至二千二百三十七美元。第四根K线继续上攻至二千二百四十三美元。第五根K线进一步攀升至二千二百四十五美元，创出近期反弹新高。连续五根K线的重心逐步抬升，表明短期底部正在构筑。

值得注意的是，在价格急跌过程中，出现约三千五百枚以太坊的交易所提币，表明鲸鱼资金正在逢低吸纳。这种大户买入行为通常被视为底部信号之一。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，当前价格运行在七周期均线二千二百三十五美元之上，但低于二十五周期均线二千二百五十七美元和九十九周期均线二千三百零五美元。均线系统呈现空头排列，短中长期均线依次从上到下排列，表明整体趋势仍偏空。但七周期均线已开始走平并略微上翘，显示短期下跌动能减弱。

MACD指标显示，DIFF值为负二十五点二七，DEA值为负三十一点零九，柱状图为正五点八二。MACD虽然仍处于零轴下方，但柱状图连续五个周期放大，从正一点零四逐步扩大至正五点八二，表明空头动能持续衰减。若柱状图继续扩大，MACD有望在未来数根K线内形成金叉。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI为五十八点零二，十二周期RSI为三十九点八九，二十四周期RSI为三十九点三三。短周期RSI已从之前的超卖区域（曾跌至二十六点四九）快速回升至中性区域，显示短期反弹动能较强。但中长周期RSI仍处于四十以下，表明中期趋势尚未扭转。

KDJ指标显示，K值为七十三点二二，D值为六十二点三五，J值为九十四点九五。J值已进入超买区域，短期存在技术性回调的可能。但K线在D线之上运行，整体呈多头排列，短期上涨趋势仍在延续。

布林带方面，价格运行在中轨二千二百三十九美元之上，上轨为二千二百五十九美元，下轨为二千二百一十九美元。价格从下轨附近反弹至中轨之上，显示短期走势有所改善。但布林带仍在扩张，表明波动率较高，市场尚未进入稳定状态。

ATR指标显示，十四周期ATR为十九点六五，较之前的二十一点六七有所下降，表明价格波动幅度正在收窄，市场可能即将选择方向。

三、市场情绪分析

当前以太坊市场情绪呈现分歧。一方面，ETF资金流出和科技股暴跌对情绪形成压制；另一方面，鲸鱼资金的逢低吸纳和币安储备证明的发布，为市场注入了一定信心。

从链上数据来看，以太坊验证者入场队列从此前的三百七十万枚下降至约一百零四万枚，表明质押需求有所减弱。这可能与价格下跌导致质押收益率相对吸引力下降有关。然而，大户在价格急跌过程中的买入行为，显示其对以太坊中长期价值仍持乐观态度。

宏观层面，英国央行加息和美联储加息预期升温，对包括以太坊在内的风险资产构成持续压力。即将到来的美国非农就业数据和失业率数据，将成为市场情绪的重要催化剂。若数据强劲，可能进一步推升加息预期，对以太坊形成压制；若数据疲软，则可能缓解紧缩担忧，为反弹提供空间。

综合来看，以太坊短期面临二千二百六十美元至二千三百美元的均线压力区，下方二千二百二十美元为关键支撑。若能有效突破二千二百六十美元并站稳，有望向二千三百美元发起挑战。反之，若跌破二千二百二十美元，则可能进一步下探二千一百七十美元区域。

The hackers swapping XRP for BTC looks more like choosing a money-laundering route that is “harder to freeze and easier to absorb” than having already cashed out. For this assessment to hold, we would need to see the swaps continue, XRP balances keep falling, and BTC being dispersed or consolidated at the address level.

First, the facts. According to PANews, citing Elliptic’s tracking on November 6, around 1,650 BTC (approximately $124 million) linked to the Binance hack had entered new Bitcoin addresses—nearly twice the amount seen the previous day. Most of the newly added BTC came from swapping XRP for BTC through THORChain. Of the 233 million XRP transferred by the hackers to six new addresses on November 2, around 42 million (approximately $50 million) has been moved out, leaving about 192 million (approximately $226 million). A small amount of ETH was also swapped for BTC through THORChain on the evening of November 5.

My observation is that the key question about this route is not “what was it swapped for,” but “why was it swapped for that asset.” Once large addresses on the XRP Ledger are flagged, subsequent transfers are more likely to be monitored. THORChain enables cross-chain swaps, allowing assets to be converted into BTC, which has deeper liquidity, and then moved into numerous new addresses—making tracking and freezing more difficult. This is a preference driven by the mechanics of the process; it does not mean the hackers have secured their funds, nor does it mean BTC’s price will come under pressure as a result. The information available in this case provides no evidence of any sales or transfers to exchanges.

Based on this, three conditions are worth monitoring next: first, whether the remaining approximately 192 million XRP continues to flow out through THORChain; second, whether the new BTC addresses continue to spread the funds out or consolidate them into a small number of addresses; and third, whether there are signs that funds are entering centralized exchanges. If the swaps stall, XRP balances stop declining, or BTC addresses remain highly concentrated and inactive for an extended period, the assessment that the hackers “prefer the asset with the deepest liquidity” should be taken with a grain of salt. This article does not constitute investment advice.

$BTC

黑客把XRP换成BTC，更像是在选一条“更难被冻结、更容易被吸收”的洗币路径，而不是已经完成套现。这个判断要成立，得看到兑换持续、XRP余额继续下降，同时BTC在地址层面出现分散或归集的变化。

先看事实。据PANews 11月6日援引Elliptic的追踪，币安被盗事件相关资金已有约1650枚BTC（约1.24亿美元）进入新的比特币地址，接近前一天的两倍；新增部分主要来自通过THORChain把XRP换成BTC。黑客11月2日转入6个新地址的2.33亿枚XRP中，已转出约4200万枚（约5000万美元），剩余约1.92亿枚（约2.26亿美元）；11月5日晚还有少量ETH经THORChain换成BTC。

我的观察是，这条路径的关键不在“换成了什么”，而在“为什么换成它”。XRP账本上的大额地址一旦被标记，后续转移更容易被盯着；THORChain提供跨链兑换，把资产换到流动性更深的BTC，再进入大量新地址，追踪和冻结的难度都会上升。这是机制层面的偏好，不等于黑客已经安全落地，也不等于BTC价格会因此承压——本次素材没有提供任何卖出或入交易所的证据。

据此推断，接下来值得跟踪三个条件：一是剩余约1.92亿枚XRP是否继续经THORChain流出；二是新增BTC地址是继续分散，还是向少数地址归集；三是有没有资金进入中心化交易所的迹象。如果兑换停滞、XRP余额不再下降，或者BTC地址高度集中且长期不动，上述“偏好最深流动性资产”的判断就要打折扣。本文不构成投资建议。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你

translatedData.title: Where should you place a stop-loss? Here’s how I choose between technical levels and percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss takes more thought than whether to use one at all. Too close, and it gets triggered every day; too far, and one loss can hurt badly.

【Fixed-percentage method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward, suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop may end up right in a cluster of other traders’ stops.

【Technical-level stop-loss method】Place it where the structure fails: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if this level breaks, it means there’s evidence I got it wrong.

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

translatedData.title: Funding rates reveal bullish and bearish sentiment: Learn to read three typical scenarios
translatedData.subTitle:
Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, let’s look at how to use them as a sentiment gauge.

[State 1: Funding rates remain strongly positive] This means longs are overcrowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a peak, and a sharp “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. I’m not telling you to immediately
short, but rather: be extra cautious when going long at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates remain negative] Shorts are overcrowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic bottoms,
because everyone who was going to get out already has, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past began at times like this.

Just two days ago, we talked about this issue. Nigeria’s central bank suddenly announced it would license stablecoins, while imposing a blanket ban on algorithmic coins. This policy reversal is tougher than previously expected. BTC and ETH’s declines were driven more by sentiment than by a genuinely greater-than-expected policy shock.

📊 Data at a glance
BTC fell 5.25% in 24 hours to $76,140.01, while ETH dropped 7.24% to $2,244.18. Both are major cryptocurrencies in the global market. These declines are the complete opposite of earlier expectations that Nigeria would take a more moderate approach to regulating algorithmic coins.

- Impact on BTC: Nigeria is an important player in the global crypto market, but this sudden policy shift seems more like a response to concerns about an algorithmic-coin bubble. BTC’s decline was driven more by a release of risk-averse sentiment than by any knock-on effect from a direct crackdown on algorithmic coins weighing on stablecoins. The central bank did not mention the requirements for obtaining a stablecoin license. For now, this appears positive for compliant stablecoins, but in the short term, the market is more focused on sentiment recovering.
- Impact on ETH: ETH’s decline was greater than BTC’s, possibly because, as a foundational DeFi asset, it is more easily seen by the market as a symbol of being deeply affected by algorithmic coins. In the long run, however, clearer regulation could boost demand, so this reaction seems more like an excessive short-term emotional response.
- Forecast for capital flows: The market may continue to digest this policy uncertainty in the short term. Capital will flow out of the algorithmic-coin sector, but there is unlikely to be a large-scale sell-off of compliant stablecoins. It looks more like investors will start seeking assets with greater policy certainty after panic selling.

💡 Trading suggestions
This policy adjustment looks more like confirmation of existing risks than the creation of new ones. We recommend watching which compliant stablecoin projects attract capital flowing out of algorithmic coins, rather than simply trying to determine the direction of the entire market.
